svg.aria-label: Fibonacci dot cloud — true 3D rotation around body Y
svg.text: Fibonacci dot cloud — true 3D rotation around body Y
✓ Expected: 100 dots orbit smoothly along elliptical 2D paths. Back beads fade (opacity → 0); front beads grow slightly (perspective).
✗ If broken: Dots stay in a single screen-plane rotation, or sizes don't vary with depth.
